headline: South Korea's Sinokor Controls Half of Strait of Hormuz Oil Tankers
summary: South Korea's Sinokor controls roughly half of the tanker transits through the Strait of Hormuz after positioning its fleet prior to regional conflict.
why: Sinokor Merchant Marine is a major shipping operator focused on container and energy transportation across vital international ocean routes.

impacts.name: Sinokor
impacts.why: The company commands approximately half of all oil tanker transits through the Strait of Hormuz.
